name: erp-program
description: ERP FORWARD program skills for the PeopleSoft-to-cloud-ERP transformation: orientation (start-here), program operations (status, RAID, decisions, change management, governance navigation), source-to-import workbook building for the Import Review module, BPMN/DMN process and decision modeling against the record layer, ERP module build guides (Word docx + optional Visio swimlane), and conversion discovery with a bundled PeopleSoft SQL extract kit (metadata reading from extracts, PS Query or page screenshots; snapshot diffing; customization/security/integration/reporting analysis; process-map drafting).
